text: {"lessons":["After several monthly swings, my account is only modestly above its starting value; short-term moves alone are poor reasons to change course.","Doing nothing has spared me unnecessary trades, but I should still review whether my holdings and diversification fit my goals rather than treat inaction as a strategy.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should use a clear plan and measured risk limits instead of letting a decline trigger a fear-driven decision."]}
